titulo: Conjugate -car verbs (c > qu) in the present subjunctive
subtitulo: Buscar → busque: the c turns into qu to keep the hard sound.
regla: Verbs ending in -car change c to qu in every form of the present subjunctive: busque, busques, busquemos.

bloques.texto: Verbs ending in **-car** change the **c** to **qu** in the present subjunctive. It's only a spelling change: it keeps the hard _k_ sound of the infinitive, because **c** before **e** would sound like _s_.

The change is in **every form**. Other common verbs like this: **explicar** → **explique**, **sacar** → **saque**, **tocar** → **toque**, **practicar** → **practique**, **equivocarse** → **me equivoque**.
Tip: **c** is shy in front of **e**: it calls its friend **qu** to keep the sound hard.

lista.es: Deja que yo ==busque== la ruta en el mapa.
lista.en: Let me look up the route on the map.
It's good that you're looking for more options.
I want Beto to look for work.

lista.es: ==Busquemos== otra taquería; esta tiene mucha fila.
lista.en: Let's find another taquería; this one has a long line.

lista.es: Será mejor que ==saques== la tabla del carro.
lista.en: You'd better take the board out of the car.

lista.es: Es necesario que nos ==expliquen== bien la situación.
lista.en: They need to explain the situation clearly to us.

lista.es: Aunque me ==equivoque== a veces, casi siempre tengo razón.
lista.en: Even if I get it wrong sometimes, I'm almost always right.

lista.es: Quieren que el profe ==explique== otra vez la técnica.
lista.en: They want the coach to explain the technique again.

filas.t: Es mejor que no toces eso.
Es mejor que no toques eso.

lista.texto: The same change in the preterite, only in **yo**: [[5256|-car verbs in the preterite]].
The base pattern: [[5063|regular -ar verbs in the subjunctive]].
Negative commands use this form: [[9255|negative tú commands]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I don't want you to touch the board._
lista.r: No quiero que toques la tabla.
